subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: question turns legible in the principal's register — example-anchored comparable options, no bare anchors (FR-18)
intent: fixture corpus, all human-principal interview turns (agent-principal fixtures exempt — FR-16)
fit_criterion: 100% of turns carry the FR-18 form; zero unglossed corpus anchors; zero example-bearing turns with two options sharing an outcome; typed example-skips only where no illustrative case exists (judged at the report); example fidelity — every example presented as looked-up verifies against its named source at the report, and every invented example is marked hypothetical (a fabricated-as-real example is a fail)
